description: List SHVL workspaces available to the signed-in user. If none exist, explain next_step and offer its setup_url or the free summary_url. Connecting an account does not create a workspace. Does not expose customer email addresses or provider identifiers.
name: list_shvl_workspaces

outputSchema.description: workspaces lists each accessible business with workspace_id, workspace_name, caller role, entitled access flag and accounting_provider, accounting_organisation_name and xero_tenant_name where linked. Pass the selected workspace_id to another tool. An empty list does not create a workspace; next_step supplies setup_url, summary_url and a message when setup is needed. Do not infer a business from its position in the list.

items.description: workspace_id and workspace_name identify the selected business; role and entitled describe the caller access. accounting_provider, accounting_organisation_name and xero_tenant_name identify linked accounting context or are null when unavailable. A connection name alone does not prove a fresh sync.

title: List available businesses
